title: The coord hook drops its lease token when a coord.py call times out, so a session whose SessionEnd release timed out shows for six more hours
goal: a session whose SessionEnd release could not run while the store was busy does not show to a later session once the store is free

run:
import json,os,sqlite3,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();st=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite');E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=st)
E.pop('KB_COORD_URL',None)
H=os.path.abspath('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');T=os.path.abspath('_tools/coord.py')
def repo(n,b):
    r=os.path.join(D,n);s.run(['git','init','-q','-b',b,r],check=True);s.run(['git','-C',r,'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','i'],check=True);return r
def hook(cwd,**p):
    p.setdefault('cwd',cwd);return s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps(p),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=cwd,timeout=60).stdout
def c(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=300)
r=repo('r','work/ST-abcd1234')
hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionStart',session_id='repro-busy',source='startup')
con=sqlite3.connect(st,timeout=1,isolation_level=None);con.execute('BEGIN EXCLUSIVE')
hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionEnd',session_id='repro-busy',reason='exit')
con.execute('COMMIT');con.close()
out=hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionStart',session_id='repro-later',source='startup');hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionEnd',session_id='repro-later',reason='exit')
print(repr(out[:300]));sys.exit(0 if 'repro-busy' not in out else 1)

clauses.clause: a session whose SessionEnd release could not run while the store was busy does not show to a later session once the store is free

gates.question: How does the coord hook make a SessionEnd release that could not run reach the store once it is free?
What does the coord hook do with its lease token when a renew call times out or errors without a refusal?
options: keep the token and try again after 60 seconds
drop the token and claim again
gates.recommendation: keep the token and try again after 60 seconds

notes: Goal before the 2026-10-17 plan: SP-6jfnx5i3 review G5 (BG-iwqcj5zf, BG-yya5olzw): coord() in .claude/hooks/coord_hook.py returns (None, '') on its own 8 s timeout while coord.py waits up to 30 s on a busy store, lease() treats a failed renew as a lost token and session_end removes the state file whether or not the release worked, so after a busy store the session holds session/<id> for the full lease with no token and its intent shows to others after a clean SessionEnd. A session whose SessionEnd release could not run while the store was busy does not show to a later session once the store is free. Plan 2026-10-17: repro on origin/main b871374b4 exits 1 (the busy session's intent still shows to a later session). Runs after BG-jy6yxnq4 (same hook functions lease and session_end).
